title: Instagram Snowflake ID
summary: Instagram uses a Snowflake-style 64-bit ID: 41-bit millisecond timestamp (epoch 2011-01-01), 13-bit shard ID, and 10-bit sequence number. Instagram's IDs are 64-bit and sortable by time.

notes: 10-bit sequence number (1024 IDs per millisecond per shard).
64-bit total fits in a signed 64-bit integer.
